subject: Risk & Compliance
title: Barings Bank Collapse
description: A quick, practical guide to Barings Bank Collapse.

hook.text: One rogue trader in Singapore destroyed a 233-year-old British bank in a matter of weeks.

buildup.text: Nick Leeson made unauthorized bets on Japanese stock futures, hiding losses in a secret account.

discovery.text: By 1995, his hidden losses had reached $1.3 billion — more than the bank's entire capital.

twist.text: Barings had no separation between trading and settlement. Leeson approved his own trades.

climax.text: The oldest merchant bank in Britain went bankrupt because one person had unchecked power.

punchline.text: One trader. No oversight. A 233-year-old bank gone.

quiz.question: Why did Barings Bank collapse?
options: A rogue trader hid losses with no oversight controls
